messages:
Priya: Quick check — onboarding for `mistral-mini-v2`. Tokenizer seems to split our system sentinel oddly (<|system|>). Weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/onboard/mistral-mini-v2/weights.pt. Can someone confirm config lint and tokenizer sanity?
Luca: I can check weights path now. Quick look shows weights.pt, tokenizer.json, config.toml present. Will run lint.
Jared: FYI tokenizer maps '<|system|>' -> two tokens on this BPE ( '<|' and 'system|>' ). That causes prompt length offsets. Workaround: use '<|sys|>' sentinel or enable preserve_delim.
Priya: Is preserve_delim safe at runtime? Perf or batching issues?
Luca: Microbenchmarks show ~<1% batching perf hit in worst case. Safe. Add to model config like:

```toml
preserve_delim = true
chat_template = "<|sys|>"
bos_token = ""
eos_token = ""
```

Jared: Also add '<|sys|>' to tokenizer.special_tokens and map to a stable id. That prevents boundary splits.
Ruth: QA concern: will this change shift KV cache offsets or break replay tests? Need to run prompt_boundary suite.
Jared: It can shift offsets if templates tokenized differently. Replay tests will catch it. Also double-check padding + truncation behavior.
Priya: @infra-bot can you kick off the onboarding-lint job for this model?
infra-bot: Started onboarding-lint/1729992468 — checking weights checksum, tokenizer schema, and config validation. ETA ~3m.
infra-bot: Lint result: weights checksum OK. tokenizer.schema error: special_tokens missing '<|sys|>' entry. config.toml OK except missing preserve_delim flag. See: https://ci.redwood/inference/onboard/1729992468
Luca: pushed tokenizer update adding '<|sys|>' -> id 32001. New tokenizer.json version uploaded to gs://redwood-models/onboard/mistral-mini-v2/tokenizer.json (v2).
qa-bot: Replay tests queued: prompt_boundaries suite (10 prompts).
Ruth: Great — if replay passes we can flip preserve_delim default in rollout policy. I'll monitor.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll update the PR with the config snippet and note about perf. :thumbsup:
